name: connect-apps-plugin
description: Slash commands for managing Claude's app connectors (Slack, Notion, Linear, Gmail, and more): list what's connected, find new ones, and troubleshoot connection issues.

commands.name: connectors-list
commands.description: List the user's app connectors and their connection status.

commands.name: connectors-find
commands.description: Search the MCP connector registry for an app or task.

commands.name: connectors-troubleshoot
commands.description: Diagnose why a specific connector isn't working.
